title: RL2AC: Reinforcement Learning-based Rapid Online Adaptive Control for Legged Robot Robust Locomotion
title_zh: RL2AC：基于强化学习的快速在线自适应控制用于腿式机器人鲁棒运动
abstract: —Dynamic fast adaptation is one of the basic capabilities that enables the animals to timely and properly adjust its locomotion reacting to the unpredictable changes. Such capability is also essential for the quadruped robot, when working in the unforseen environment. While reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved a signiﬁcant progress in locomotion control, rapid adaptation to the model uncertainties remains a challenge. In this paper, we seek to ascertain the control mechanism behind the locomotion RL policy, from which we propose a new RL-based Rapid onLine Adaptive Control (RL2AC) algorithm to complementarily combine the RL policy and the adaptive control together. RL2AC is run at a frequency of 1000Hz without the need for simultaneous training with RL. It presents a strong capability against the external disturbances or the sim-to-real gap, resulting in a robust locomotion, which is achieved through proper torque compensation derived from a novel adaptive controller. Various simulation and experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed RL2AC against the heavy load, disturbances acted on one leg, lateral torque, sim-to-real gap and various terrains.
abstract_zh: 动态快速适应是动物应对不可预测变化时及时调整运动的基本能力之一。这种能力对于四足机器人在未知环境中工作也至关重要。尽管强化学习（RL）在运动控制方面取得了显著进展，但对模型不确定性的快速适应仍然是一个挑战。本文旨在探究运动RL策略背后的控制机制，并据此提出一种新的基于RL的快速在线自适应控制（RL2AC）算法，将RL策略与自适应控制互补结合。RL2AC以1000Hz的频率运行，无需与RL同时训练。它通过一种新颖的自适应控制器产生适当的力矩补偿，对外部扰动或仿真到现实的差距表现出强大的抵抗能力，从而实现鲁棒运动。各种仿真和实验证明了所提出的RL2AC在重负载、单腿扰动、横向力矩、仿真到现实差距以及各种地形下的有效性。
tldr_zh: 提出RL2AC算法，结合RL与自适应控制，实现腿式机器人快速在线自适应。
cover_zh: 机器人运动控制新突破｜RL2AC让四足机器人快速适应未知扰动
